title: Enforce compiler promotion gates and gateway boundaries
summary: Add mechanical preflight enforcement for decision/planning/implementation promotion gates while preserving gateway/audit boundary safety fixes.

goal.outcome: CodeWiki blocks lower-layer promotion and routes ambiguity back to decision when required upstream evidence is missing, stale, failed, blocked, or semantically incomplete.
acceptance: Planning preflight requires a decision_build plus decision-gateway pass unless the change declares and validates a mechanical/runtime/generated exemption.
Implementation/resume preflight requires a planning_build plus planning-gateway pass before selecting an executable roadmap task.
Ambiguous lower-loop cases block and route to decision with deterministic decision-question evidence instead of agent inference.
Task close/publication still requires implementation validation/content proof and is not weakened by the new checks.
Gateway/audit dynamic-regex and boundary safety findings remain addressed or explicitly covered by the same validation path.
Smoke tests prove missing, stale, failed, blocked, and ambiguous upstream evidence prevents promotion while valid upstream-pass paths continue.
non_goals: Do not implement UI approval surfaces in this task.
Do not implement agency runner automation in this task.
Do not implement production quality thresholds in this task beyond preserving existing validation proof requirements.

delta.desired: Promotion gates and ambiguity back-routes are enforced by preflight/tool/runtime checks, not only by agent instructions.
delta.current: Docs require gated loop order and ambiguity routing, but tools can still create or consume lower-layer artifacts without hard upstream gateway proof.
delta.closure: Task closes when tests prove invalid promotion paths block and valid upstream-pass paths continue.
